review_basis: All 12 integrated records were manually compared with all original title/abstract evidence sentences and the unchanged policy. Acceptance rests on role, semantic-unit, artifact, named-resource, subject/coreference, condition, modality, comparator, magnitude and coverage checks; hashes and lexical validation are additional provenance/structure checks only.
provenance: Author A sealed its source-first draft before B cross-review. This is a revision review of the integrated candidate after adjudication, not a new blind pass, not self-acceptance of A's draft, and not human-gold certification.
